title: Document Classification input
description: One document to classify. Provisional: until extraction is built (Phase 2), the caller supplies the document's extracted text. The final input, a file path or an embedded file, is decision 4.

document_id.description: The caller's identifier for the document. It is echoed in the decision and never sent to the model.

text.description: The document's extracted text. The filename is deliberately not part of the input.
